segments.name: air transportation
segments.description: Air transportation of passengers, goods and cargo, grouped geographically into domestic and international destinations.
segments.evidence: The Group has determined that it has one operating segment: air transportation, identified in the following geographical destinations: (1) Domestic and (2) International.

revenueModel.text: Passengers pay for flights by destination, and loyalty members and partners generate revenue recognized when Aeromexico Rewards points are redeemed.
revenueModel.evidence: All the AR Points earned by the Aeroméxico Rewards members are accounted as a liability (frequent flyer program) and are recognized as revenue when the awards are redeemed.
